description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and the Macro-F1 Score (%) for two different model configurations: “MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information”. The x-axis, labeled “Number of tokens”, spans a linear scale from approximately 0.5 to 1.5, with major tick marks at 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, and 1.4. The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, ranges from 48 to 58, with major grid lines and tick labels at intervals of 2 percentage points (48, 50, 52, 54, 56, 58). The “MATTER (ours)” line is rendered in a reddish-brown color with circular markers and a solid line; it begins at approximately 55.0% at 0.5 tokens, dips slightly to 54.5% at 0.6 tokens, rises to a peak of 58.0% at 1.0 tokens, and then declines to 50.8% at 1.5 tokens. The “w/o material information” line is shown in a dark gray or purple color with circular markers and a solid line; it starts at 52.5% at 0.5 tokens, increases to 54.2% at 0.7 tokens, then gradually decreases to 51.8% at 1.3 tokens before dropping sharply to 47.5% at 1.5 tokens. Both lines are accompanied by semi-transparent shaded regions representing uncertainty or confidence intervals, which are wider for “MATTER (ours)” and narrower for “w/o material information”.
